one_line: Nvidia investigates its CEO over an affair, AI labs expand energy and data center capacity, and tech firms face new financial and legal pressures.

themes.title: Nvidia board investigates CEO over affair
themes.text: Nvidia's board launched an independent investigation after CEO Jensen Huang admitted to an extramarital affair with an executive whom U.S. officials allege is a Chinese spy. The board stated it has no reason to believe company secrets or national security were compromised.

stories.headline: Nvidia board launches investigation after CEO Jensen Huang admits affair
Nvidia board launches probe into CEO Jensen Huang over alleged spy plot
Nvidia board investigates CEO Jensen Huang over affair with alleged Chinese spy

themes.title: AI labs scale up energy infrastructure
themes.text: Anthropic purchased $3.4 billion in commitments for 1.7GW of gas-fired generators, while Envision Group opened a gigawatt-scale datacenter in Inner Mongolia and ByteDance considered expanding a project in Brazil.

stories.headline: Anthropic buys 1.7GW of gas-fired generators in $3.4B deal
Envision Group opens gigawatt-scale Galaxy AI datacenter in Inner Mongolia
ByteDance considers data center expansion in Ceará, Brazil

themes.title: Market pressures and corporate tool restrictions
themes.text: AI companies sold or priced over $300 billion in stock amid market questions, Goldman Sachs restricted AI coding tools to technical staff, and reports highlighted investor focus on capital requirements.

stories.headline: AI companies sell $300B+ in stock in 2026 amid market absorption questions

themes.title: Software mergers and AI strategy shifts
themes.text: Apple's CEO pressed for an accelerated agentic AI strategy, Ada and Dialpad merged their customer service software, and music publishers filed copyright lawsuits against Suno.

stories.headline: Ada and Dialpad merge to combine AI customer service software
